{{Quote|Leaping lizard, that dance was really wizard!|A Gungan DJ|<ref name="ELAC">''[[Star Wars: Early Learning Activity Center]]''</ref>}}
'''Deesco''' was a genre of music and dance practiced by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]],<ref name="ELAC" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Distinctive traits of the deesco were free-form dancing and [[Color/Legends|colorful]] lightings on the dancefloor. In the underwater city of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]], a [[Hydrostatic bubble/Legends|hydrostatic bubble]] was specifically designed for deesco dancing. The Gungan [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] was known to be a motivated deesco dancer. Known deesco dance moves included the "Jumping Jack", the "Ballet Spin", the twist, giving high kicks in the air and waving one's arms high and slow.<ref name="ELAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Deesco dancing was one of the six activities featured in ''[[Star Wars: Early Learning Activity Center]]'', a children's video game released in [[2000]] by [[Lucas Learning]]. The name and characteristics of that style hint at a parody of [[Wikipedia:Disco|disco]], a popular genre of music in the 1970s. A similar reference to disco would later appear in the [[2003]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'', where the opening featured several ''Star Wars'' characters doing disco dancing under a [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]-shaped glitterball. The game's arcade mode would also activate a disco ball with [[Wikipedia:Meco|Meco's]] disco-inspired remix for the ''Star Wars'' theme when the player approaches the Arcade machines.
